doc: Exit criterion 1 (and 3), on mocks. One plan, three tasks routed by role to three providers: a subscription Claude, a Gemini, and an API-key profile (`:ai`, through the gateway). Codex stays refused as a worker until its lock is proven (CODEX_LOCK_PROVEN), so the three providers here are Claude, Gemini and the API-key profile, and a fourth, Codex, profile is refused. The preset is Balanced with one user cell (code.edit asks for the mock-gemini profile). Every worker asks to edit: the Claude and the API-key worker are answered at once by the matrix (the mock logs allow_once) and make no card; the Gemini worker waits behind exactly one open matrix card and gets its answer only from the user (agents/permission). A worker's push to main is never under Balanced (matrix/check). The manager half of the criterion (a worker asked by the manager to use a permission the manager lacks is refused) needs the manager's tools of Task 25 and is covered by that task's rows, not here. It fails if a worker is started on the wrong profile, if an in-matrix action makes a card or waits, if an ask runs without a card or an answer, or if Codex starts as a worker.
